build_aya_vision_model: build an AyaVision multi-modal projector that applies SwiGLU and pixel-shuffle to align vision features with text embeddings
create_aya_vision_get_image_features: create image features from pixel values using the vision tower and multi-modal projector in AyaVisionModel
run_aya_vision_forward: run the AyaVisionModel forward pass to combine text input embeddings with image features for multi-modal understanding
generate_aya_vision_conditional: generate text conditioned on images using AyaVisionForConditionalGeneration with chat templates and token generation
test_aya_vision_pretrained: test the AyaVisionPreTrainedModel base class that extends LlavaPreTrainedModel with compile graph disabled
